scope: Finite population and estimator controls; no image classification or new image pixels
assumptions: Joint cumulants use all three centered pairings, including noncircular complex pairings
Gain/noise invariance is population-only, for nonzero scalar gains and additive jointly Gaussian noise independent of the signal
A finite three-point surrogate matches Gaussian moments only through order four; it is not a Gaussian distribution
Unbiased fourth k-statistic assumes iid sample vectors; spatial image windows are not assumed iid

finite_estimator.negative_control: Repeat one random symbol four times; unbiased formula no longer estimates the iid population cumulant

centering_counterexample.claim_to_check: After per-vector DC removal, the entire finite sign-output distribution is invariant under one-pixel circular shift

negative_controls: treat zero-cycle energy cumulant as cyclic artifact
treat normalized cumulant as bounded by one
gate.timing: First bounded execution is a pilot; record actual runtime before any larger compute
